recon.expected_result: Evidence-linked service map update and candidate questions

vuln.expected_result: Supported or unresolved hypothesis with decisive evidence

access.expected_result: Actual access outcome, evidence and pending triage

verify.purpose: Resolve a particular contradiction or ambiguity
verify.expected_result: Evidence-linked resolution or a precise remaining ambiguity

http-surface.purpose: Observe a discovered scoped HTTP resource
http-surface.expected_result: Original capture reference, result_id, exact observation and uncertainty

capture-audit.purpose: Local audit of saved original HTTP or loose Git evidence
capture-audit.expected_result: Validated quotation/provenance or explicit audit failure; no new GET

access-triage.purpose: Triage the current confirmed access level
access-triage.expected_result: Only missing current-level triage categories, each with result_id and exact quote
